<objective>
Deliver the edit-in-place character page with autosave (ADR-0003): creating a character lands on `/c/:id`, and the masthead edits name, species/build, pronouns and orientation. Every edit reaches IndexedDB within a second and on tab hide. Load failures are routed with specific messages and never touch stored data. The portrait area is a non-circular monogram frame suited to full character art (D-P1).

Purpose: ROADMAP success criteria 1 and 2, plus the SCHM-03 user surface.
Output: CharacterStore, CharacterHeader, CharacterPage, the `/c/:characterId` route, and create-then-navigate on the library.

Scoped assumption (D-P1): CHAR-01's "optional portrait image" is satisfied in Phase 1 by the `portrait: ImageRef | null` schema field (01-01) and this monogram frame. The upload control and image rendering arrive with the Phase 4 image pipeline (GALL-04), and exact frame sizing is decided there.
</objective>

  <action>
Implement CharacterStore (providedIn root) per SPEC-frontend-architecture sections 3-4 and ADR-0003, for Phase 1 scope. Page add, remove, reorder and updatePage are Phase 2 (CHAR-04/05) and are not built here.

- Signals:
  - `character = signal<Character | null>(null)`
  - `core = computed(() => this.character()?.core ?? null)`
  - `pages = computed(() => this.character()?.pages ?? [])`
  - `dirty = signal(false)`
  - `restoring = signal(false)`
- Export `CharacterNotFoundError` (name 'CharacterNotFoundError', field `id`).
- `load(id)`:
  - First `await this.flush()`, so switching characters never drops an edit.
  - Then set `restoring` true.
  - In a try block: `const c = await repo.get(id)`; if null, throw CharacterNotFoundError; set the private `lastPersisted` field to c; `character.set(c)`; `dirty.set(false)`.
  - In `finally`, set `restoring` false.
  - Errors propagate, and character() keeps its prior value.
- `updateCore(patch)` accepts a Partial of CharacterCore excluding id and portrait. It is a no-op when character() is null. Otherwise it sets a new Character with the merged core and `updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()`.
- The autosave `effect(onCleanup)` reads character():
  - It returns early when the character is null, when it is the SAME REFERENCE as `lastPersisted`, or when `untracked(() => this.restoring())` is true.
  - Otherwise it sets dirty true and schedules `setTimeout(() => this.persist(c), 500)`, keeping the handle in a private field; onCleanup clears it.
  - Add a one-line comment: in zoneless Angular this effect runs after load()'s finally has already reset restoring, so the reference check is what actually suppresses the load-triggered save.
- The private `persist(c)`:
  - `await repo.put(c)`, then set `lastPersisted = c`, and set dirty false only if `character() === c`.
  - On error, call `snackbar.showError('Your latest changes could not be saved. They are still in this tab.')`, log `console.error('[CharacterStore]', err)`, and leave dirty true.
- `flush()` returns when dirty() is false or there is no character. Otherwise it clears the pending timer and awaits persist(character()).
- In the constructor, subscribe `fromEvent(document, 'visibilitychange')` (only when document.visibilityState is 'hidden') and `fromEvent(window, 'pagehide')`. Both call `void this.flush()`, with `takeUntilDestroyed(inject(DestroyRef))`.
- The persistence request stays inside CharacterRepo.put (01-01). The store never calls navigator.storage.
  </action>
  <verify>
    <automated>pnpm --filter @dossier/schema build && pnpm --filter web exec ng test --watch=false --include=src/app/stores/character.store.spec.ts --include=src/app/integration/autosave-persist.integration.spec.ts</automated>
    <fails_when>non-zero exit, or "No tests found" in the output</fails_when>
  </verify>
  <acceptance_criteria>
    - Both spec files pass and cover every behavior bullet. The 1000 ms bound is asserted with `vi.waitFor(..., { timeout: 1000 })`.
    - `rg -q 'untracked\(' apps/web/src/app/stores/character.store.ts` exits 0, and `rg -q 'lastPersisted' apps/web/src/app/stores/character.store.ts` exits 0.
    - `rg -q "'pagehide'" apps/web/src/app/stores/character.store.ts` and `rg -q "'visibilitychange'" apps/web/src/app/stores/character.store.ts` both exit 0.
    - `rg -q 'navigator.storage' apps/web/src/app/stores/character.store.ts` exits 1.
  </acceptance_criteria>
  <done>Edits autosave within a second, on tab hide, and never on load; the persistence request happens only after a real write; load failures change nothing.</done>
</task>

  <action>
Build `CharacterHeader` (selector `cd-character-header`, standalone, OnPush) per SPEC-design-system 4.1 and D-P1.

- API: `core = input.required<CharacterCore>()` and `coreChange = output<Partial<Pick<CharacterCore, 'name' | 'species' | 'pronouns' | 'orientation'>>>()`.
- `<header class="masthead">`:
  - an eyebrow reading "Character Dossier · reference sheet"
  - a `.portrait-frame` (aria-hidden) containing a `.monogram` span
  - an `<h1>` wrapping the `.title-input` name input (aria-label "Character name", maxlength NAME_MAX, hint text "Character name")
  - a `.meta-row` of three `.meta-field` blocks, each with a `<label for>` and an input with maxlength SHORT_TEXT_MAX: Species / build (id cd-species, hint "e.g. human, fox-morph, tall & lean"), Pronouns (id cd-pronouns, hint "e.g. she/her") and Orientation (id cd-orientation, hint "e.g. bisexual, demiromantic")
- Inputs bind `[value]` from core(). `(input)` removes every character matching `/[^\P{Cc}\n\t]/gu` and then emits the one-field patch.
- `monogram = computed(...)` takes the first grapheme of the trimmed name via `new Intl.Segmenter(undefined, { granularity: 'grapheme' })` and upper-cases it with `toLocaleUpperCase()`. It is the empty string for an empty name.
- Styles (component SCSS, tokens only, no component-local colors):
  - Masthead and inputs follow the prototype: transparent inputs with a bottom border only, and an accent bottom border on focus.
  - `.portrait-frame`: `aspect-ratio: 3 / 4`, width calc(var(--space-10) * 3) (120 px), and under 700 px width calc(var(--space-8) * 3) (96 px). Border 1px solid var(--border), background var(--surface-2), border-radius var(--radius-lg), display grid with centered content, overflow hidden.
  - `.monogram`: var(--font-display) at weight 600, size var(--text-title), color var(--text-muted).
  - The frame radius must never be the full radius token or a percentage (D-P1: no circle).
  - Layout: flex-wrap row, with the frame first and the name/meta column `flex: 1; min-width: 0`. `.meta-row` wraps to one column under 700 px.
- Render text with interpolation or property binding only.
  </action>
